tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open quarter-finals wrap Tuesday with Aryna Sabalenka surviving a thriller against Linda Noskova and Frances Tiafoe rallying from two sets down to beat Alex Michelsen — both advance to the semis as Alcaraz faces Shelton Wednesday • [SQUASH] Qatar Classic Platinum tournament opens September 12 in Doha with world No. 1 Mostafa Asal chasing his first title and Nouran Gohar making her return after maternity leave • [BADMINTON] Asian Games countdown begins as world No. 1 An Se-young departs for Japan after her historic third straight China Masters crown and seventh title of 2026 • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup kicks off today at The Hood with up to $300,000 in prize money and five days of pro action across Malaysia • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao 2026 continues Day 2 with more Round of 32 singles play — Huang Youzheng faces Kanak Jha and Wang Yidi meets Dina Meshref at the East Asian Games Dome

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Set for Star-Studded Return
newsItems.excerpt: The Qatar Classic Platinum event returns to Doha September 12–18, headlined by world No. 1 Mostafa Asal seeking his first title and Nouran Gohar making her PSA comeback after maternity leave.

newsItems.title: Asian Games on the Horizon
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se-young heads to Japan after securing a third straight China Masters crown — her seventh title of 2026 — as badminton's Asian Games begin September 19 in Aichi-Nagoya.

newsItems.title: Kuala Lumpur Cup Kicks Off
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup opens today at The Hood for five days of world-class pickleball, with up to $300,000 in prize money and the Pickletown fan festival running alongside.

newsItems.title: Macao Champions Day Two
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao continues Wednesday with more Round of 32 singles — China's Huang Youzheng faces USA's Kanak Jha and Wang Yidi takes on Egypt's Dina Meshref at the Macao East Asian Games Dome.
